widths.boundary_rule: Source approximates the mean northward velocity profile by V(x)=17 exp(-(x/8)^2), x in km and V in cm/s, and calls 8 km mean effective width. OSW infers center-to-e-folding scale from the equation; no paired-edge full span is admitted.
widths.extraction_method: Transcribed source fit scale and 15-crossing count; metric interpretation inferred algebraically from stated Gaussian equation. No figure digitized or converted full width added.
widths.geographic_scope: Northern branch near the western Hopen Deep / Spitsbergen Bank polar frontal zone, Barents Sea. Not the Central branch or whole North Cape system.
widths.layer: Composite vertical support unresolved. Fig. 9 specifies a 20–80 m average for LS05; Fig. 10 does not explicitly establish that same fixed layer for all 15 crossings. Instrument generally sampled from about 20 m to 150 m or 15 m above bottom.
widths.name: North Cape Current — Northern branch
widths.range_interpretation: Approximate fitted effective scale; no fit confidence interval or annual variability range supplied.
remaining_gates: Resolve exact composite depth averaging and crossing dates from underlying data.
Define comparable paired boundaries before any full-width comparison.
Review branch identity and along-route support; canonical admission remains pending.
widths.section_orientation: Distance from frontal-section center across individual crossings; northward geographic velocity component fitted. Exact paired geographic boundaries unresolved.
widths.source_citation: Morozov, Pavlov, Pavlova and Fedorov (2017), Polar Frontal Zone of the Barents Sea Western Trough Based on the Direct Measurements in 2007, Physical Oceanography 2, 36–50, doi:10.22449/1573-160X-2017-2-36-50.
widths.source_locator: Abstract; Introduction pp. 36–37; Instruments p. 37; Stationary currents p. 38; Currents pp. 45–47, Fig. 9 and Fig. 10, especially Gaussian-fit paragraph on p. 47.
widths.time_convention: 15 frontal crossings during summer expeditions in 2007. Paper describes a 29 May–10 June 2007 cruise, but exact composite sampling bounds are unresolved; not a recurring seasonal width.
